description:
Save a call to your own HTTP endpoint as an integration. Attach it to an agent with `attachAgentIntegration`, and the agent calls the endpoint during a call when the conversation needs it, then uses the response in its reply. Parameters marked `isLLMGenerated` are filled in by the agent from the conversation.
(Tags: Integrations)

body_params.description:
Request body fields, sent as JSON. A GET request sends no
body. Every request with a body also carries the call's
`from_number`, `to_number` and `call_sid`.

items.description:
One query or body parameter of a custom API. With `isLLMGenerated`
true the agent fills the value from the conversation, guided by
`description`. With it false, the text in `description` is sent as a
fixed value.

children.description: Nested fields of an `object` or `array` body parameter. Query parameters have no children.

description.description: What the agent should put here, or the fixed value when `isLLMGenerated` is false.

isLLMGenerated.description: Let the agent fill this value from the conversation.

key.description: The parameter name your endpoint expects.

required.description: Whether the agent must supply this parameter.

description.description:
What the endpoint does. The agent reads this to decide
when to call it, so say what it returns and when it is useful.

headers.description: Fixed headers sent on every request.
